profile.about: I'm a software developer focused on React.js and frontend development. As a Software Developer Intern at UNICO International (July – December 2025), I worked on the company's website, building responsive React.js pages and components. I have a working knowledge of financial markets, trading fundamentals and fintech concepts, and I currently manage and lead activities across VFUTURES and Enroute UAE, coordinating operations, social media and lead generation.
